:::{#exr-score-second-moment}
#### Second moment of the score

Under the assumptions of @exr-score-mean-zero,
show that $\E{\score^2} = \einf(\th)$,
the [expected information](#def-einf).
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-score-second-moment}

By @exr-score-mean-zero,
$0 = \int \paren{\deriv{\th} \log \p(\vx \mid \th)} \p(\vx \mid \th) \, d\vx$
for every $\th$.
Differentiate this identity with respect to $\th$;
the third step uses @exr-deriv-log-density:

$$
\begin{aligned}
0
&= \int \deriv{\th}\sb{\paren{\deriv{\th} \log \p(\vx \mid \th)} \p(\vx \mid \th)} d\vx
&& \text{(exchange derivative and integral)}\\
&= \int \paren{\frac{\partial^2}{\partial \th^2} \log \p(\vx \mid \th)} \p(\vx \mid \th) \, d\vx
 + \int \paren{\deriv{\th} \log \p(\vx \mid \th)} \deriv{\th}\p(\vx \mid \th) \, d\vx
&& \text{(product rule)}\\
&= \E{\hess} + \int \paren{\deriv{\th} \log \p(\vx \mid \th)}^2 \p(\vx \mid \th) \, d\vx
&& \text{($\deriv{\th}\p = \paren{\deriv{\th}\log \p} \p$)}\\
&= \E{\hess} + \E{\score^2}
&& \text{(definition of expectation)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Rearranging:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{\score^2}
&= \E{-\hess}
&& \text{(subtract $\E{\hess}$ from both sides)}\\
&= \E{\oinf}
&& \text{(observed information is the negative Hessian)}\\
&= \einf(\th)
&& \text{(definition of expected information)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
